datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework across Zimbabwe's administrative divisions. Classification data were spatially encoded as geographic features with IPC phase values and scenario projections for 2021, aggregated by collection period.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys, providing near-term projections of acute food insecurity across administrative units in Zimbabwe.
